DESIGN PREMISE

The design of artificial intelligence should begin with ethical principles. Symbolic reasoning makes deliberate design possible through explicit concepts, relations, and reasoning structures rooted in human intelligence. SRA draws its meaning and purpose from this human source, enabling us to take responsibility for the intelligence we build and thereby fulfill the ethical principle that guides its design.

THE PROJECT

About SRA
Motivation
Architecture
Video series

Symbolic Reasoning Agent is Yannick Fontan’s research project for interactive games. The agent uses explicit representations of observations, mechanisms, and goals to organize its reasoning.

The 100 games on this page run locally in your browser. The ongoing SRA Agent migration transfers V6 capabilities into native TypeScript and the common V7 reasoning architecture. Coordinate inputs, guarded action sequences and memory across levels are connected. The original Python game engines remain isolated from the agent. Explore the shared reasoning syntax in the Logos Engine Reasoning Lab.
